paragraphs: Chicago's large enterprises — AT&T (Chicago presence), Boeing Chicago, Morningstar, and Hyatt — often standardize on Microsoft. Azure OpenAI provides GPT-4o within the Azure tenant's existing compliance and security framework — ClickMasters deploys Azure OpenAI as the default for Chicago's Microsoft-ecosystem clients.

blocks.heading: Self-hosted for Chicago's privacy-sensitive organizations

blocks.heading: Chicago's financial recordkeeping
paragraphs: LLM applications for Chicago's broker-dealers and FCMs that produce client communications may require FINRA or CFTC recordkeeping — ClickMasters designs financial LLM applications with recordkeeping compliance as a design input.

blocks.heading: Azure OpenAI dominance
paragraphs: Chicago's large Fortune 500 enterprises — AT&T, Boeing, Walgreens, Archer Daniels Midland, Kraft Heinz — largely standardize on Microsoft technology stacks. Azure OpenAI is the dominant LLM deployment path for Chicago's enterprise market, providing GPT-4o within the existing Azure compliance infrastructure that Chicago's enterprises already maintain for SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

blocks.heading: On-premise for regulated industries
paragraphs: Chicago's derivatives industry (CME, Cboe) and major law firms (Kirkland & Ellis) are among the most data-sensitive enterprise segments in any US city. For these clients, ClickMasters defaults to self-hosted Llama 3 deployment on client infrastructure as the first recommendation — cloud APIs come only after confirming that data governance requirements allow external transmission.

blocks.heading: BIPA constraining voice LLM
paragraphs: Chicago's BIPA exposure has created notable caution around voice-enabled LLM applications — most Chicago enterprises specifically request text-interface-only LLM deployments to avoid BIPA's biometric voice authentication requirements.
